title: QBR ops: pipeline velocity, forecast stitch & account snapshots
text:
QBR ops: pipeline velocity, forecast stitch & account snapshots

["From: Rohan Mehta <rohan.mehta@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 10 Jul 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: QBR ops: pipeline velocity, forecast stitch & account snapshots

Team —

QBR is two weeks out. I want to lock the sales-facing slide set this week so the exec readout reflects the most up-to-date runway. Focus areas: pipeline velocity (where deals are stalling), forecast consolidation (net ARR / weighted close by close date), and 1-page account snapshots for the top 12 deals.

Asks (priority order):
- Marissa: can you produce 1-page snapshots for the attached prioritized accounts using the template? Keep it to 1 page each (deal health, ask, next step, top risk). Due: EOD Mon 11 Jul.
- Karthik: run a consolidated forecast rollup that includes committed vs. best-case buckets, and surface any close-date drift vs. last month. Attach CSV to your reply. Due: Tue 12 Jul morning.
- Laura / Ben: I need a short paragraph from each of you (2–3 lines) on any enterprise-level risks to highlight in the QBR (procurement, legal, or exec signoff delays).

We'll stitch these into the master deck (link below). If ACME or others ask for an updated timeline, be explicit about where we have supporting evidence (PO status, SOC docs, technical POC completion).

Template & master deck: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1AqzQBR-template
Priority accounts list attached (see subject).

Thanks — keep replies tight (one-line summaries where possible).

— Rohan
Rohan Mehta
Head of Sales Operations, Redwood Inference
rohan.mehta@redwood.com

Rohan — attaching the 1‑page snapshots for the 12 prioritized deals (ACME included). File: ACME_account_summary_July2027.xlsx (contains contact, milestone, last engagement, close probability). Snapshot notes in-line where relevant.

High-level notes:
- ACME: procurement signoff pending security questionnaire (owner: Lisa Tran); deal moved ~2 weeks from our last update.
- Meridian Health: POC completed; finance needs SOW for final approval.
- LumiTech: still a high-probability close this quarter but pricing table needs approval.

Attachments: ACME_account_summary_July2027.xlsx; qbr_account_snapshot_template.docx

', 'From: Lisa Tran <lisa.tran@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Rohan Mehta <rohan.mehta@redwood.com>
Cc: ACME RevOps <revops@acme.com>
Date: Mon, 11 Jul 2027 14:40:05 -0700
Subject: Re: QBR ops: pipeline velocity, forecast stitch & account snapshots

Hi Marissa / Rohan —

Thanks for the snapshot. Quick update from our side: procurement has the security questionnaire and will complete the review by Jul 20 (we pushed a hard block on July 18 for internal legal). Expected PO issuance timeline is now end of July.

We can confirm the total ARR is unchanged; we’ve adjusted internal close probability to 85% and moved the target close date to 2027-07-29. I’ll upload the signed NDA and a redacted SOC excerpt to your Drive link once legal finishes their review.

If you need the SOC details earlier for the QBR, let me know and I can expedite a redacted section to Marissa.

— Lisa
Lisa Tran
Head of Vendor Programs, Acme Analytics
lisa.tran@acme.com
', 'From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Rohan Mehta <rohan.mehta@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 12 Jul 2027 09:05:44 -0700
Subject: Re: QBR ops: pipeline velocity, forecast stitch & account snapshots

Rohan — attached the consolidated forecast rollup (forecast_rollup_v2.csv). Quick summary:
- Net committed ARR (this quarter): $3.2M
- Best-case upside (weighted): $1.1M
- Identified 4 deals with date drift > 14 days (ACME, LumiTech, Zenith Labs, Meridian Health).

Proposed adjustment for the QBR slide: show committed vs upside split, then a small waterfall that removes deals with >14-day drift from committed for an alternate conservative runway. This gives execs both optimism and a conservative plan.

Attachment: forecast_rollup_v2.csv

On Mon, Jul 11, 2027 at 10:23 AM Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com> wrote:
> Rohan — attaching the 1‑page snapshots for the 12 prioritized deals (ACME included). File: ACME_account_summary_July2027.xlsx (contains contact, milestone, last engagement, close probability). Snapshot notes in-line where relevant.

', 'From: Rohan Mehta <rohan.mehta@redwood.com>

Cc: ACME RevOps <revops@acme.com>, Lisa Tran <lisa.tran@acme.com>
Date: Tue, 12 Jul 2027 15:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: QBR ops: pipeline velocity, forecast stitch & account snapshots

Thanks everyone — great, concise thread. Quick consolidated decisions and owners before I pull the deck together: 

- Use committed ($3.2M) and show a separate upside column ($1.1M). Karthik, you own the numbers slide (I’ll put you down as deck owner).
- Marissa: finalize the 12 one‑page snapshots and drop into the Drive folder under /QBR/Account_Snapshots. I’ll pull 2–3 callouts for the readout (ACME procurement delay; Meridian SOW; LumiTech pricing approval).
- Laura & Ben: please reply to this thread with your 2–3 line enterprise risk bullets by EOD Wed 13 Jul. I’ll include them verbatim.
- ACME: Lisa — appreciate the timeline update. If you can share a redacted SOC excerpt to the Drive folder before Jul 18 that will help us call out the mitigation in the QBR.

Master deck link: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1AqzQBR-template

I’ll produce the draft executive slides by Thu 14 Jul for internal review.

— Rohan
Rohan Mehta
Head of Sales Operations, Redwood Inference
rohan.mehta@redwood.com
